column4: Pixel-art sprite exactly in the style, pixel size and palette of the reference image, a 1990s Build-engine game sprite (Duke Nukem 3D, Blood), flat pure magenta #FF00FF background, no text. A single big splash of fresh dark red blood as if it hit a camera lens or a pane of glass straight on: an irregular splat with thick runs dripping downwards from its lower edge, wet highlights, darker clotted middle, a few small spatter drops around it. Flat, seen straight on.

First-person view looking down at your own forearm in torchlight at night: the sleeve of a brown work jacket torn open and the forearm under it ripped open to the bone, raw red flesh, torn skin, dark blood pouring out over the fingers of a work glove, harsh flash photograph, grainy, Loab-like, horrific.

A horrifying close-up of a human face seen in a dark puddle of blood as a reflection: the same face as the viewer's, torn and wrong, one eye hanging, the jaw ripped loose, flies on it, grainy flash photograph, Loab-like, morbid, almost unreadable in the dark.

Pixel-art sprite in the style of a 1990s Build-engine game (Duke Nukem 3D, Blood), dark background, no text. First-person view looking down at your own hand in a brown leather work glove in torchlight at night, the glove torn across the back and soaked through with fresh dark blood, a deep gash in the hand under it, blood running between the fingers and dripping off them, the torn sleeve of a brown work jacket. Harsh flash photograph look, grainy, gritty, horror.
